main_body: Wooden cart bed (brown box on two wheel/leg posts) carrying three grey pots with flowering plants
top_band: none: the cart bed shows only a thin 2-3 row lighter brown rim (rows ~10-12) above a dark brown line at row 13. The pots cover the rest of the top, so no bed surface reads as a horizontal plane.
evidence: Down a middle column the bed goes: pot bottoms, a dark line at rows 12-13, then mid brown from rows 14-19 with no lighter surface. That is a flat front face with a rim line. There is no distinct front-edge highlight, and the bed's top surface is not visible. The right-hand lighter patch and handle are small details. The cart reads as a front elevation, like the guide's 'rim only' and 'front elevation' failures.

style.evidence: The plants are well built, with several greens plus red and yellow flowers, and the outlines are dark brown or dark green rather than black. The cart bed is a large brown area with only 3-4 tones and little grain, so it is flatter than the reference stall and well, which have per-tile highlights, planks and stone shading. The grey pots use about 3 tones. Overall the piece is thinner than the references, and the bed and wheels are low in information.
